frames.title: Lesson 47 · Mixed Conditionals — practice and contrast

body: **Foco:** Mixed Conditionals — introdução — prática e contraste.
**Verbos:** emphasize.
**Pronúncia:** Redução de palavras funcionais (to, of, for, and, can).
**20 palavras novas** (economia básica).
**Texto do dia:** resenha / review.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (B2):** eu consigo contrastar condicionais mistos e comuns numa resenha e usar emphasize.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Review: “Money Matters” (book) ★★★★☆
paras: The author **emphasizes** that if we **had learned** about money at school, we **would be** better off today. If she **were** less honest, she **wouldn’t have written** such a candid book. If you **read** it now, you **will understand** why.
I loved the examples, though a few **felt** repetitive. **Overall**, a strong argument.

items.q: The author says we should have learned about money.
The book is described as dishonest.
The reviewer found some examples repetitive.

head: Tipo
Exemplo
rows: If we had learned, we would have saved.
If we learned, we would save.
If we had learned, we would be better off.
If she were less honest, she wouldn’t have written it.

blocks.body: Para falar de **efeito atual de algo passado**, use *had + particípio → would + base*.

items.s: If we had learned, we ___ be better off. (would)
If she were less honest, she wouldn’t have ___ it. (write, part.)
The author ___ that money education matters. (emphasize, 3ª)
If you read it, you ___ understand. (will)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Better off.** — Em situação melhor.
**Learn the hard way.** — Aprender na marra.
**Financial freedom.** — Liberdade financeira.
**Money doesn’t grow on trees.** — Dinheiro não cai do céu.
**Rich in experience.** — Rico em experiência.
**What does the author emphasize?** — O que a autora enfatiza?
**Is she honest?** — Ela é sincera?
**If we had learned about money, we’d be better off.** — Se tivéssemos aprendido sobre dinheiro, estaríamos melhor.
**Get on board.** — Entrar a bordo.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
